description: Retrospective. Colour is addressed by role, never by hue: eleven tokens, and nothing outside the palette block names a colour. Shades derive with color-mix rather than hardcoded rgba. Palettes are [data-theme] blocks rather than :root-only, so a Settings swatch can be the palette rather than a duplicate of it. Selection lives in localStorage per device, applied before first render so the chosen palette paints instead of the default.
title: Role-based colour tokens and a palette picker
